lines.beaver: 소식 들었어요? 다음 달에 새 항로가 개통된대요.
lines.beaver_en: Did you hear? A new route opens next month.
lines.beaver_roman: Sosik deureosseoyo? Daeum dare sae hangnoga gaetongdoendaeyo.
lines.learner: 정말요? 그 항로에는 어떤 선박이 다녀요?
lines.en: Really? What ship runs on that route?
lines.roman: Jeongmallyo? Geu hangnoeneun eotteon seonbagi danyeoyo?

lines.beaver_en: It's a ship called the Bada. Incheon to Jeju.
lines.learner: 바다호요? 승합차나 소형차도 실을 수 있어요?
lines.en: The Bada? Can it carry vans or compact cars too?
lines.roman: Badahoyo? Seunghapchana sohyeongchado sireul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 차도 실을 수 있대요. 차는 안 가져가세요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it can take cars. Aren't you bringing a car?
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, chado sireul su itdaeyo. Chaneun an gajeogaseyo?
lines.learner: 차는 안 가져가요. 항구까지 도보로 갈 수 있어요?
lines.en: No car. Can I get to the port on foot?
lines.roman: Chaneun an gajeogayo. Hanggukkaji doboro gal su isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: It's a 10-minute walk from the last subway stop.
lines.en: Is the paving on Haebyeon-ro by the port done?

lines.beaver: 네, 다 됐어요. 회사에서 출장 때 배를 타래요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's done. The company wants us to take the ship on business trips.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, da dwaesseoyo. Hoesaeseo chuljang ttae baereul taraeyo.
lines.en: By ship? Are they trying to save on fuel costs?

lines.beaver: 그것도 있고, 회사 차 브레이크가 자주 고장 나서요.
lines.beaver_en: That too, and the company car's brakes often break down.
lines.beaver_roman: Geugeotdo itgo, hoesa cha beureikeuga jaju gojang naseoyo.
lines.learner: 배가 더 안전하겠네요. 배에도 안전벨트가 있어요?
lines.en: The ship must be safer. Does it have seat belts too?
lines.roman: Baega deo anjeonhagenneyo. Baeedo anjeonbelteuga isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 좌석에 있대요. 또 궁금한 거 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: They're on the seats. Anything else you want to know?
lines.beaver_roman: Jwaseoge itdaeyo. Tto gunggeumhan geo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 항구 가는 길을 내비게이션으로 찾을 수 있어요?
lines.en: Can I find the way to the port on the navigation?
lines.roman: Hanggu ganeun gireul naebigeisyeoneuro chajeul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, type in Seohae Port and it shows up.
lines.en: What time does the Bada leave Incheon?

lines.beaver: 매일 아침 9시예요. 첫 배는 다음 달 1일이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Every morning at 9. The first sailing is next month's 1st.
lines.beaver_roman: Maeil achim ahopsiyeyo. Cheot baeneun daeum dal iririeyo.
lines.learner: 저는 운전을 안 해서 배편이 좋아요.
lines.en: I don't drive, so going by ship suits me.
lines.roman: Jeoneun unjeoneul an haeseo baepyeoni joayo.

lines.beaver_en: Then shall we ride it together on the first day?
lines.en: Sounds good. Let's meet at the port on opening day.
